note: Synthetic cases for the cover letter fact check (npm run eval:letters). One invented candidate, invented companies, example.com addresses. Each error letter has one planted error; a planted error is found when a contradicted or unsupported claim mentions one of its words. Clean letters should have no flagged claims.

## 1. Summary
Engineering leader with 15 years in software and 9 years leading teams in logistics and payments. Contact: jordan@example.com.

## 2. Experience
**Director of Engineering, Northwind Logistics (2019 to 2024)**
- Led 32 engineers across four teams: routing, tracking, billing, and the internal platform.
- Cut deploy time from two days to three hours by moving to trunk based development and automated release checks.
- Led the move from the company's own data center to AWS, saving $1.2 million a year.

**Engineering Manager, Bluebird Payments (2015 to 2019)**
- Managed a team of nine engineers.
- Built a fraud detection service that cut chargebacks by 25 percent.

**Senior Software Engineer, Bluebird Payments (2009 to 2015)**
- Built the merchant onboarding service in Java.

## 3. Education and certifications
- B.S. in Computer Science, Lakeside State University, 2009.
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Associate (2021).

## 4. Skills
Java, Go, Python, AWS, Kubernetes, hiring and growing managers, incident response.

harborline.title: VP of Engineering
harborline.jd_text: Harborline Shipping is rebuilding its routing platform. We want a VP of Engineering who has led 30 or more engineers, run a cloud migration, and built a strong release process. An MBA is a plus.

kestrel.title: Head of Platform
kestrel.jd_text: Kestrel Health runs a care scheduling product used by 400 clinics. Our Head of Platform owns reliability, the AWS footprint, and the developer platform for 60 engineers. PMP certification preferred.

orchard.title: Director of Engineering
orchard.jd_text: Orchard Retail is growing its online store. The Director of Engineering leads three teams, owns checkout and payments, and partners with fraud and finance. Ten years of experience required.
